components.name: Search result
components.description: Title and muted metadata in a list row.
components.css: .ds-result{font-family:var(--vscode-font-family);font-size:var(--vscode-font-size,13px);border:1px solid var(--vscode-input-border,transparent);border-radius:2px;padding:5px 10px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;padding:10px 6px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:var(--vscode-foreground);border-bottom:1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border);}.ds-result strong,.ds-result span{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-result strong{font-weight:600;}.ds-result span{color:var(--vscode-descriptionForeground);margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;}.ds-result:hover{background:var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground);}.ds-result:active{filter:brightness(.95);}.ds-result:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Current lyric
components.description: Current synchronized line; state follows playback.

narrative.overview: Operate mode is quiet, compact, and familiar. The sidebar inherits the user's VS Code theme. Metadata, source selection, and search establish context; lyrics receive the flexible reading space. The approved direction excludes artwork and playback controls.
keyCharacteristics: Compact metadata, source selection, and search.
Lyrics as the primary reading surface.
Flat surfaces and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Host Theme Rule
rules.body: Preserve VS Code theme variables; do not introduce an independent light/dark palette or synthesized tonal ramps.

dos: Do inherit host theme colors and font family.
Do keep metadata and search compact so lyrics receive the flexible reading space.
Do retain labels, keyboard focus, text selection, wrapping, and high-contrast borders.
Do convey the current lyric with weight and underline as well as color.
Do respect reduced motion and pause following during manual reading.
donts: Don't introduce artwork or playback controls into this sidebar.
Don't add an independent palette, decorative typeface, or shadows.
Don't turn lyric lines into cards or hide manual search behind another surface.
